decisions.reason: Ending this freelancer's video-delivery task does not retract or alter the previously established product benefits and claims, which may remain applicable to campaign work performed elsewhere.
The client terminates the current delivery engagement but does not change the desired realism or UGC visual style.
The source ends the current delivery task without retracting or modifying any script keyword or wording constraint.
The landing-page and tracking audit was already deferred and is unrelated to termination of the test-video delivery task.
